observation_unit: one volunteer with one post-workshop self-report
group_unit: a fictional workshop; its participants share a setting, not an assigned treatment contrast

variables.student_id: unique synthetic identifier Wxx-Syy, one per row
variables.confidence_score: 0 to 100 self-reported confidence score in points; generated to one decimal; no before score

assignment: none; workshops and volunteers are not sampled at random
